notes: This contract pins the private Annex C.7 update-rate composition rule. Same-name update rates are compared with the first definition: an identical duplicate is ignored, while any differing name/rate/semantics/note sub-element fails composition. Referenced notes are compared by note content after Umbra's per-module label remapping. Omitted DIF fields remain representable for partial rows. This is source/test traceability only, not update-rate runtime or conformance evidence.
